# Official AIUI reference snapshot

Source: https://github.com/yodaos-project/AIUI

Revision: 00c6ec71ee313817705683248b3ebe2acf0937f0

Upstream project declares Apache-2.0. Original author notices and file contents are retained. This directory contains official documentation and the public aiui-dev skill, with references and starter assets. Upstream internal repository-maintenance skills are not distributed.

The live updater verifies each downloaded file against its Git blob hash, then atomically activates a complete snapshot.
